causal_findings: J9 was not a localization failure: StringUtils.java was the sole reference-loaded production source and was reached at logical index 10.
The frozen empty-segment parser mechanism was correctly inapplicable because its only candidate targeted LocaleUtils.java.
The human repair performs the same expression-level rewrite at two sibling join implementations.
The inherited repair language can mutate scalar boundaries, symbols and field modifiers, but cannot infer and coordinate a shared expression rewrite across analogous sibling methods.
J6 and J9 independently show that real repairs often require a repair plan containing multiple coordinated edits rather than one atomic mutation.
claim_boundary: J9 remains a valid negative. The revealed fix may train the new planner but may never be used to reclassify J9 as a pass.
next_development_change: Replace the one-new-specialist-per-failure loop with a capability-routed compositional repair planner. It should represent atomic edits as a small IR, infer applicability from failing-test traces/source structure, compose bounded multi-edit plans, coordinate analogous sites, rank by causal evidence, and retain explicit provenance. J1-J9 become consumed training evidence; future J10+ cases remain unseen qualification holdouts.
